newsitem.title: USA: USDA extends comment period on meat export report.
newsitem.headline: USDA extends comment period on meat export report.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department Tuesday said it was extending the comment period on its proposal to begin collecting data on meat export sales by 30 days.
The department said it was acting to allow additional time for interested parties and industry to consider the proposal.
Two major meat industry groups had written USDA asking for an extension so they could get input from their members.
The deadline for comments has been extended until Feb. 12. The department unveiled its proposal to release weekly export sales data on beef, pork and poultry last month.
